overall_assessment: All available laboratory values are within normal limits, yielding a normal lipid panel with a protective HDL level. No critical or abnormal findings are present. However, the patient has overweight (BMI 26.6) and stage‑1 hypertension (134/90 mmHg), indicating moderate cardiovascular risk that is not reflected in the lipid data alone. Comprehensive evaluation with additional metabolic, renal, hepatic, hematologic, inflammatory, and endocrine labs is recommended to fully assess risk and end‑organ status.
